room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Optional add-on can cap to 1% of SI/day (max ₹7,500) for a premium discount.

icu.note: ICU charges paid at actuals; proportionate deduction does not apply for ICU.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on every admissible claim. Additional 20% co-pay if non-network hospital (i.e. total 20% on non-network; waivable with 15% loading).

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI max ₹40,000 per claim per eye. Domiciliary: max 10% of SI per year. No PED 50% sub-limit (Plan B only).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Joint replacement surgery excluded for 36 months (or 36 months from Silver Health inception if switching from Plan A). Listed 25 conditions have 12-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of base SI. Reduced by 10% after a claim year.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned for Plan B.

domiciliary.note: Covered for illness requiring >3 days home treatment when hospitalisation not possible. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.).

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, joint replacement (36mo wait), 10% co-pay on all claims, no global cover, dental (non-accidental), domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma etc.
optional_riders: Room rent capping add-on (1% SI/day, max ₹7,500 – earns premium discount); waiver of non-network co-pay (15% loading)
